_comment: Data for setup.ps1 -InstallPython (R6), read by scripts/lib/rt-python-env.ps1 and scripts/docs/python_libs.py. One list for both Python environments of the repository: each entry of 'environments' is built in the main clone, in file order. pip-audit is a tool of the first environment only and audits the requirements files of both, so the docs environment never gains pip-audit's dependencies. A path that does not exist is reported by name, never skipped (R3). An 'exclude' entry names a package the installer drops from a requirements file before pip sees it: the file itself is never edited, because the skill that owns it still wants the line.

environments.name: .venv-skills
environments.why: The interpreter of the offline suite, the dashboard and every skill script the repository runs.

requirements.why: paper2talk: test_to_a4 (pypdf), the Jinja render path (jinja2), test_talk_pptx (python-pptx), OOXML reads (defusedxml)

scopus: requests (scopus_api, download_pdf), google-genai and openai (reviewers), curl_cffi (publisher tier), playwright (browser_fetch tier 8; the Chromium binary is a separate 'playwright install chromium')
extract-statistic: pymupdf and pymupdf4llm (extract_text.py), markitdown, psycopg and pgvector (corpus_index.py)

tools.why: security.md: pip-audit runs on every requirements file this installer applies. Pinned to the version found in the working environment on 2026-10-16; the install step used to call it without ever installing it.

environments.name: .venv-docs
environments.why: The interpreter that builds the MkDocs site (mkdocs build --strict, mkdocs gh-deploy).

requirements.why: mkdocs, mkdocs-material and the build hook scripts/docs/mkdocs_hooks.py, pinned with their transitives (D3)

venv_probe_timeout_s.provenance: chosen 2026-10-16 (R4): a scratch 'python -m venv' takes a few seconds on this machine; the ceiling only has to be finite (R10) and generous on a slow disk
